headline: The permanent Core now meets its size target. Stream is being prepared for external audit and launch evidence.
summary: Development has continued since the contract snapshot reviewed on these pages. This update follows the latest checked Stream commit while keeping the review record exact.

recentlyCompleted.text: The permanent Core fits within Ethereum's contract-size limit with 5,579 bytes of headroom.
Retained fork checks cover artwork metadata in browsers and marketplace and indexer behavior.

workingOn.text: Confirming the exact contract set, permissions, settings, and connections for launch.
Refreshing the fork deployment, operating ceremony, and randomizer rehearsals after the latest Core changes.
Strengthening metadata writers, payment settlement, and controlled contract changes.

beforeLaunch.text: Run the public testnet rehearsal and publish the verified addresses and source.
Complete an independent external audit and retest every accepted fix.
Approve the final settings, deployment records, and operating rehearsals.

reviewerPrompts.question: Does the path from curation decision to signed sale approval feel understandable and fair?

reviewerPrompts.title: Minting and supply
reviewerPrompts.question: Are collection limits, token numbering, and mint controls easy to follow?

reviewerPrompts.question: Can artists and collectors tell where sale proceeds and royalties go?

reviewerPrompts.question: Does the randomness process provide the right mix of fairness, recovery, and explanation?
